newsitem.title: UK: Finelist to buy Heywood unit, sets placing.
newsitem.headline: Finelist to buy Heywood unit, sets placing.

text.p: British car parts company Finelist Group Plc said on Thursday it agreed to buy Maccess from Heywood Williams Group Plc for 23.0 million stg in cash and the repayment of 9.6 million stg of debt.
To help finance the acquisition, Finelist said it planned to raise some 41.0 million stg net by way of a 3-for-16 placing and open offer of 12.45 million new ordinary shares at 345p per share.
The firm expected the buy to be earnings enhancing.
Maccess, a cash and carry retailer of replacement vehicle parts and other items, had a pretax profit of 3.0 million stg in 1996 on turnover of 58.9 million stg.

"Maccess will fit easily within our culture and, with the existing management team, we expect to be able to develop the business further," Finelist said in a statement. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
